subject: Copywriting
title: Personalization in Subject Lines
description: A quick win: understand Personalization in Subject Lines.

hook.text: Emails with the recipient's first name in the subject line get 26% higher open rates. A name demands attention.

buildup.text: The cocktail party effect: you hear your name across a noisy room. The same happens scanning a crowded inbox.

discovery.text: Beyond names, personal data works: 'Your flight to Paris' beats 'Flight confirmation.' Specificity signals relevance.

twist.text: Overuse killed personalization. 'Hey {First_Name}!' feels robotic now.

climax.text: The best personalization references behavior: 'You viewed this 3 times.' Behavioral data is the new first name.

punchline.text: Names work. Behavior data works better. Personalize with actions.

quiz.question: How much do personalized subject lines boost open rates?
